input.content: Search the web: who designed the Eiffel Tower? One sentence.

The Eiffel Tower was designed by engineers Maurice Koechlin and Émile Nouguier, with architectural enhancements by Stephen Sauvestre, under the leadership of Gustave Eiffel. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eiffel_Tower?utm_source=openai))
In which year was it finished? One sentence.
The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889.
